managers.title: Chief Executive Officer
managers.name: Maren Okafor
managers.background: Joined two weeks ago from a European payments company. Board meeting at the end of January.
managers.remit: The whole business: growth, which merchants and verticals matter, where Tidewick earns its money, what is going well and what is not.

managers.title: Chief Financial Officer
managers.name: Tobias Lindqvist
managers.background: New this month, previously finance director at a retailer. Preparing the 2025 annual accounts and the 2026 budget.
managers.remit: Tidewick's own revenue (plans and processing fees), merchants' gross volume, refunds, payouts, receivables of the B2B merchants, tax across countries, currency exposure.

managers.title: Chief Operating Officer
managers.name: Priya Raman
managers.background: Came from a third-party logistics provider. Wants to know how reliable the delivery promise is that merchants make on Tidewick.
managers.remit: Fulfillment, warehouses and stock, carriers and delivery times, returns logistics, suppliers and purchase orders, how the busy season went.

managers.title: VP Customer Experience
managers.name: Daniel Achterberg
managers.background: Former head of support at a marketplace. Merchants run their helpdesk on Tidewick, so their shoppers' experience is partly Tidewick's reputation.
managers.remit: Support tickets and response times, returns and refunds from the shopper's side, reviews and ratings, satisfaction, what shoppers complain about.

managers.title: Head of Growth Marketing
managers.name: Chloé Marchetti
managers.background: Joined from a direct-to-consumer brand. Wants to sell merchants more of Tidewick's marketing tools.
managers.remit: Shopper acquisition and channels, campaigns and email, coupons and promotions, loyalty and referrals, experiments, whether marketing spend by merchants pays off.

managers.title: Head of Merchant Success
managers.name: Samuel Whitcombe
managers.background: New in the role, owns the relationship with the largest merchants and quarterly business reviews with them in January.
managers.remit: Health of individual merchants: their sales, their shoppers, retention, plan usage, which merchants are at risk and which are thriving. Often from one merchant's point of view.

managers.title: Head of Risk and Payments
managers.name: Aylin Demir
managers.background: Previously in fraud operations at a bank. Responsible for payment performance and for keeping bad actors out.
managers.remit: Payment success and failure, gateways, disputes and chargebacks, fraud and abuse, account security, refunds that look wrong.

managers.title: VP Product
managers.name: Jonas Feld
managers.background: Joined from a mobile-first retailer. Deciding the 2026 roadmap.
managers.remit: How shoppers use storefronts and apps, the checkout funnel, search, subscriptions as a product, B2B features, which features merchants adopt.

managers.title: Head of Data
managers.name: Rosa Van den Berg
managers.background: Took over the analytics team last week. Before the team's numbers go to the board she wants to know how far they can be trusted.
managers.remit: Data quality and consistency in the warehouse: duplicates, gaps, timestamps, reference data, metrics that disagree with each other.

managers.title: Chief Information Security Officer
managers.name: Henrik Aalto
managers.background: Joined from a cloud provider's security team. Several enterprise deals depend on passing security reviews.
managers.remit: Account security for merchants' staff and shoppers: sign-ins, sessions, multi-factor authentication, API tokens and service accounts, access to sensitive data, audit trails.

managers.title: Data Protection Officer
managers.name: Ines Laurent
managers.background: Lawyer by training, previously at a European marketplace. Also reports to the board's audit committee.
managers.remit: Personal data: consent, privacy requests, retention and deletion, legal holds, data exports, and what the platform keeps about shoppers.

managers.title: VP Platform Engineering
managers.name: Diego Morales
managers.background: Former reliability lead at a payments company. Owns uptime and the integrations merchants depend on.
managers.remit: Reliability of the platform: background jobs, scheduled tasks, health checks, rate limits, webhooks and integrations, imports, feature flags, and how incidents affect merchants.

managers.title: Head of Merchandising
managers.name: Freya Lindgren
managers.background: Came from a fashion marketplace's catalog team. Responsible for helping merchants present their products well.
managers.remit: Merchants' catalogs: products and variants, attributes, categories and collections, bundles, media, reviews, and how catalog quality relates to sales.

managers.title: Head of Pricing and Promotions
managers.name: Marco Bianchi
managers.background: Previously in revenue management at a travel company.
managers.remit: Prices and price lists, price rules, promotions and coupons, the cost of discounts, and taxes on sales.

managers.title: Head of Lifecycle Marketing
managers.name: Aisha Rahman
managers.background: Ran customer messaging at a subscription box company.
managers.remit: Email, SMS and push messaging, notifications, deliverability, unsubscribes and preferences, segments, loyalty and referral programmes.

managers.title: Head of B2B Commerce
managers.name: Patrick O'Neill
managers.background: Built B2B sales teams at a software company. Owns the B2B features wholesale merchants run their sales on.
managers.remit: The B2B side of the platform: leads, pipelines and opportunities, quotes and deal lines, company accounts, contacts and tasks, payment terms, and whether merchants' sales teams succeed with them.

managers.title: Director of Fulfilment Operations
managers.name: Tomasz Nowak
managers.background: Ran warehouses for a large retailer before joining.
managers.remit: What happens inside merchants' warehouses: receiving and inbound receipts, lots and serial numbers, stock locations, reservations, adjustments and counts, picking, packing and parcel tracking.

managers.title: Support Operations Manager
managers.name: Mia Schultz
managers.background: Built support tooling and processes at a software company.
managers.remit: How the helpdesk is run: agent groups and staffing, macros, the knowledge base and its feedback, SLA policies and breaches, tags and routing.

analysts.name: Hannah Brooks
analysts.style: methodical: starts with an overview, then drills into whatever looks unusual

analysts.name: Kofi Mensah
analysts.style: hypothesis-driven: states what he expects and designs reports that would prove him wrong

analysts.name: Lena Hartmann
analysts.style: skeptical: checks definitions and sanity totals before trusting a trend

analysts.name: Mateo Ruiz
analysts.style: comparative: likes year-over-year and peer comparisons across merchants and countries

analysts.name: Sofie Nilsen
analysts.style: storyteller: looks for the two or three findings that matter and digs until each is explained

analysts.name: Arjun Patel
analysts.style: segmenter: breaks totals down by merchant size, vertical, country and channel

analysts.name: Claire Dubois
analysts.style: time-series minded: weekly and daily trends, before and after, seasonality

analysts.name: Emeka Obi
analysts.style: customer-centric: follows cohorts of shoppers or merchants over time

analysts.name: Yuki Tanaka
analysts.style: detail-oriented: picks specific merchants, products or days and looks at them closely

analysts.name: Noah Fischer
analysts.style: systems thinker: maps how one process feeds the next before measuring anything

analysts.name: Priyanka Desai
analysts.style: auditor's mindset: traces individual records end to end to check that the totals are real

analysts.name: Lucas Moreau
analysts.style: pragmatic: answers the question asked with the simplest reliable report

analysts.name: Zara Ahmed
analysts.style: exploratory: looks at the raw detail of an unfamiliar area before aggregating it

analysts.name: Oliver Grant
analysts.style: peer-minded: compares each merchant with peers of similar size and vertical

analysts.name: Ingrid Solberg
analysts.style: risk-focused: looks for the tail, the outliers and the worst cases

analysts.name: Daniel Kim
analysts.style: funnel thinker: measures each step of a process and where things drop out

analysts.name: Fatima Zahra
analysts.style: definition-minded: checks what each field really records before relying on it

analysts.name: Ben Carter
analysts.style: quantifier: puts a money value on every finding

engineers.name: Grace
engineers.style: Writes tidy, layered CTEs with descriptive names, one step per CTE, then a final select.

engineers.name: Felix
engineers.style: Junior engineer who nests subqueries in FROM and WHERE (IN, EXISTS, correlated subqueries) rather than CTEs.

engineers.name: Ines
engineers.style: Thinks in window functions: ranks, running totals, LAG/LEAD for comparisons, percent-of-total.

engineers.name: Viktor
engineers.style: Old-school warehouse engineer: explicit JOIN chains straight to the base tables, derived tables, GROUP BY with CASE pivots, few CTEs.

engineers.name: Bea
engineers.style: Writes SQL the way the company's BI tool generates it: verbose fully qualified aliases (t0, t1, ...), a subquery per measure joined back on the grain keys, COALESCE everywhere.

engineers.name: Omar
engineers.style: Pragmatic: the shortest correct query, aggregates first and joins dimensions afterwards, FILTER clauses for conditional counts.
